/// <summary>
/// Fluxor reducers for <see cref="OrderProjection"/> state transitions.
/// </summary>
public static class OrderProjectionReducers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Handles <see cref="OrderProjectionLoadRequestedAction"/>. Post-transition results require this request's correlation.
    /// </summary>
    [Fluxor.ReducerMethod]
    public static OrderProjectionState OnOrderProjectionLoadRequested(OrderProjectionState state, OrderProjectionLoadRequestedAction action)
        => state with { IsLoading = true, Error = null, RequiresScopedRequest = false, ActiveCorrelationId = state.HasChangedScope ? action.CorrelationId : null };

    /// <summary>
    /// Handles <see cref="OrderProjectionLoadedAction"/>. A post-transition result needs a matching request first; direct initial results remain supported.
    /// </summary>
    [Fluxor.ReducerMethod]
    public static OrderProjectionState OnOrderProjectionLoaded(OrderProjectionState state, OrderProjectionLoadedAction action)
        => state.RequiresScopedRequest || (state.ActiveCorrelationId is not null && state.ActiveCorrelationId != action.CorrelationId)
            ? state : state with { IsLoading = false, Items = action.Items, Error = null };

    /// <summary>
    /// Handles <see cref="OrderProjectionLoadFailedAction"/>. A post-transition failure needs a matching request first; direct initial failures remain supported.
    /// </summary>
    [Fluxor.ReducerMethod]
    public static OrderProjectionState OnOrderProjectionLoadFailed(OrderProjectionState state, OrderProjectionLoadFailedAction action)
        => state.RequiresScopedRequest || (state.ActiveCorrelationId is not null && state.ActiveCorrelationId != action.CorrelationId)
            ? state : state with { IsLoading = false, Error = action.Error };

    /// <summary>Clears prior-scope projection rows and load provenance.</summary>
    [Fluxor.ReducerMethod]
    public static OrderProjectionState OnOrderProjectionScopeChanged(OrderProjectionState state, global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.Navigation.ScopeChangedAction action)
        => new(IsLoading: false, Items: null, Error: null) { RequiresScopedRequest = true, HasChangedScope = true };
}
